text: dsh-claude-subscription（DSH 网页客户端插件）：让 DSH 通过 Claude 订阅账户使用 Claude 模型。它注册按账户区分的模型提供方路由，并提供登录、账户、退出和用量命令。用户可在模型设置页管理账户模型，在输入区查看订阅用量指示器。适合希望在 DSH 中使用 Claude 订阅的用户；需要通过 OAuth 登录 Claude 账户。

dsh-claude-subscription (DSH web plugin): Use Claude models in DSH with Claude subscription accounts. It registers account-specific model routes and provides login, account, logout, and usage commands. Users can manage models in Settings and see quota by the composer. OAuth sign-in is required.
想用自己的 Claude 订阅在 DSH 里调用 Claude 模型。
怎么在 DSH 里登录 Claude 账户并管理可用模型？
I want to check my Claude subscription quota while using DSH.
dsh-claude-subscription 的功能「Claude 订阅模型接入」：登录 Claude 账户后，插件为该账户注册独立模型路由，供 DSH 选择并发送模型请求。通过 `/claude-login` 开始授权。
dsh-claude-subscription 的功能「账户与用量查看」：用户可用命令查看账户登录状态、订阅用量和重置时间；网页输入区还显示当前订阅账户的用量指示器。
dsh-claude-subscription 使用前须知：OAuth、模型请求和用量读取会连接 Anthropic 服务。（见 lib/oauth.js:31-34、lib/adapter.js:30、lib/usage.js:24）

@apcamargo/dsh-claude-subscription README · Getting started：Sign in from any session:

```
/claude-login
```

It prints an authorization link and opens it in your browser. Approve it there to grant the plugin access to your subscription.

@apcamargo/dsh-claude-subscription README · Using multiple accounts：You can run `/claude-login` multiple times to add additional accounts. Each one becomes its own group in the model picker, labeled with the email associated with it.

Whichever account is signed in at [claude.ai](https://claude.ai/) in your browser is the one that gets added. Sign in to the account you want first, or open the authorization link in a private window.

@apcamargo/dsh-claude-subscription README · Commands：| Command                           | What it does                                     |
| --------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------ |
| `/claude-login [email]`           | Sign in, add an account, or refresh a credential |
| `/claude-account [account]`       | Show the signed-in account and token expiry      |
| `/claude-usage [account]`         | Show quota usage and reset times                 |
| `/claude-logout [account\|--all]` | Sign out and delete the stored credentials       |

@apcamargo/dsh-claude-subscription README · Usage indicator：When the selected model belongs to a subscription account, a small Claude mark appears in the message composer to the left of its model selector. Its colored fill drains as your primary quota has been used, and clicking it opens a panel with detailed information.
